stories.title: Bloomberg: AI-exposed jobs in China falling faster than other roles
stories.summary: A Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings found AI-exposed roles in China declining 10 percentage points faster than other jobs, hitting entry-level and creative workers hardest.
stories.more: A Bloomberg News analysis of 10 million job postings found that AI-exposed roles in China are shrinking about 10 percentage points faster than other roles, adding to an already weak labor market. Entry-level workers and the creative industry appear hit hardest, with more than 90% of Chinese micro-dramas now made using AI. Former central bank adviser Cai Fang is quoted warning that a larger AI-driven shock to the labor market is still ahead. The excerpt doesn't break down figures by industry beyond the micro-drama example.

stories.title: Nvidia reportedly nears $500M deal for diffusion-model startup Inception
stories.summary: Nvidia is close to acquiring AI startup Inception for at least $500 million to bolster its open-source Nemotron model lineup, The Information reported.
stories.more: According to The Information, as relayed by The Decoder, Nvidia is close to acquiring AI startup Inception for at least $500 million. Inception, just two years old, builds language models based on diffusion processes rather than the token-by-token generation used by models like ChatGPT. The deal would strengthen Nvidia's own open-source model lineup, Nemotron, and support its push into robotics. Terms beyond the reported minimum price, and the deal's final status, aren't confirmed in the excerpt.

stories.title: Google adds collapsible AI Mode sidebar to search homepage
stories.summary: Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop search homepage that lets users reopen recent AI Mode searches, threads, and notebooks, pushing search further toward an AI answer engine.
stories.more: Google is globally rolling out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop search homepage. Inside AI Mode, the sidebar lets users reopen recent AI searches, search threads, and create notebooks. The update also launches temporary threads worldwide that aren't saved to search history. Google Search co-lead Robby Stein says the feature is meant to make it easier for users to continue longer web research sessions.

According to the piece, some users are leaning into the feature, using it to clean up who they follow based on reciprocity. The excerpt doesn't specify when Muse gained this capability or how widely it has rolled out.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis working with Claude, and says the method extends to the Generalized and Extended versions. The claim is not yet independently verified.
stories.more: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, says he and Claude have produced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, one of mathematics' most famous unsolved problems. In his own account, quoted by Simon Willison, Alpöge says the method 'easily extends much further,' resolving the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and, he expects with more time, the Extended Riemann Hypothesis too. He and Claude have also formalized the arguments without additional assumptions. The claim has not yet been independently verified; The Verge notes that if confirmed, it would be another major milestone for AI in mathematics. Posted as a PDF, the claim generated heavy discussion on Hacker News, drawing 1,067 points and 694 comments.

stories.title: Researchers introduce Multimodal Concept Lens to probe VLM concepts
stories.summary: A new paper introduces the Multimodal Concept Lens, built on global workspace theory, to study how vision-language models internally select and represent concepts. The authors argue current VLM outputs don't reveal this internal processing.
stories.more: The paper argues that although vision-language models combine visual and textual information, their final outputs do not show how they internally represent concepts. The authors draw on global workspace theory, which holds that information from parallel processes is selected and integrated into a shared workspace before becoming available to specialized systems. To study this inside VLMs, they introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), described as a multimodal Jacobian lens. The lens uses separate mappings for the vision encoder and language decoder, though the excerpt is cut off before describing what the analysis found.

stories.title: Signal blocks Gemini and Siri from reading phone screens
stories.summary: Signal is restricting screenshot capture on Android and iOS to stop AI agents like Gemini and Siri from reading users' messages and other on-screen data, citing privacy concerns.
stories.more: Signal said it is limiting the ability to take screenshots on both Android and iOS to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other on-screen information. Signal's president said agentic AI features built into phone operating systems, which analyze on-screen content to learn about users, are 'undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy.' The restriction specifically targets agentic capabilities in assistants such as Gemini and Siri. The excerpt doesn't specify a rollout timeline or the technical mechanism behind the block.

stories.title: Vergecast reviews a week of major tech outages
stories.summary: The Vergecast discusses a week marked by a multi-day Outlook outage, a rare nationwide flight ground stop, bank system failures, and an iCloud outage.
stories.more: This episode of the Vergecast reviews a rough week for tech infrastructure: a days-long Outlook outage, a nationwide flight ground stop that the hosts say happened for only the second time in 25 years, banking systems that seemed to stop working, and an iCloud outage. The hosts frame the week as evidence the 'technological world' is fraying, and suggest the disruptions could be an early sign of bigger problems ahead. The excerpt doesn't specify a shared cause linking the incidents, and no AI-specific angle is mentioned.
